recipe.name: Node.js app
evidence: Scripts: build, build:watch, dev, lint, lint:fix, test, prepublishOnly
Start phase boots a real n8n in Docker with this package installed and asserts n8n registers the Purelymail node and its tool variant, then serves health on port 5701. It needs docker only.

Nothing in the build, tests or start phase calls the live Purelymail API, so no token is needed here and no account is touched. The live checks live in test/manual/probe-endpoints.mjs and are run by hand, with the token supplied in the environment.

readinessPath is n8n's liveness endpoint /healthz. /healthz/readiness only turns 200 once the database is connected and migrated, and the start script itself waits for /healthz/readiness before installing the package.
Set PKG_SPEC=n8n-nodes-purelymail to make the start script install the published package by name from the registry instead of the locally packed tarball.
For build and test only, run: hermes verify --json --skip-start
